title: timeline audio ui link state gates

commit.merge_subject: merge: timeline audio ui link state gates

description:
AUD-02's link state now decides what audio the two consumers of a
clip carry — the MP4 export and the editor's audio preview. This is
the audio model's first consumer-side wiring: the state machine the
settings sheet writes is now the truth both surfaces obey.

Export (Mp4Exporter): a new audioLinkFor seam (the lutPathFor/
gyroPathFor pattern) turns the job's sourceId into the source's
CURRENT link state, resolved ONCE in export() before the engine
runs. ATTACHED — including the absent-record default, so an
unmanaged project and old imports keep the byte-identical current
output — reads and muxes the clip's audio track exactly as before.
DETACHED, REMOVED and LINKED_EDITED skip the audioInfo/readAudio
branch entirely, producing the same video-only file a clip with no
audio track produces (writer start sampleRate 0 = no audio track).
The gate threads through exportOnce to the ExportPipeli

feat: audio settings sheet with link controls
